title: The shop
sections: What is on the shelves today. Stock counts are real — when it says two left, there are two left.

How quickly do you post?
Same day if you order before two, otherwise the next working day. Everything goes in paper and cardboard, nothing in plastic.
Can I collect instead?
Yes, and it is free. Choose collection at checkout and we will have it behind the counter with your name on it.
What if it arrives broken?
Send us a photograph and we will replace it or refund you, whichever you prefer. No need to send the pieces back.
